newsitem.title: USA: Lack of traders stalls U.S West Coast prods prices.
newsitem.headline: Lack of traders stalls U.S West Coast prods prices.

text.p: U.S. West Coast product prices stalled early Thursday, with most traders leaving the market to attend an industry function, brokers said.
"They're just flat taking the day off," a West Coast broker said, adding the event would run through Friday.
Crude and heating oil prices fell on NYMEX. At 1138 PDT, December crude shed 34 cents to $24.52 a barrel while November "heat" lost 0.86 cent a gallon to 70.15 cents.
But November gasoline futures firmed 0.64 cents to 68.80 cents a gallon, as traders said they sold heavily in heating oil to buy gasoline.
